rows.evidence: Needs an attacker-supplied AVIF to reach the /_next/image optimizer. next.config.ts has no images config (default formats, no remotePatterns/localPatterns reach), public/ holds only jpg/png/svg/webp, and no code imports sharp. Patched by upgrade.
Needs exactly one entry in config.i18n.locales with Turbopack. next.config.ts has no i18n. proxy.ts auth is therefore not bypassable through this path. Patched by upgrade.
Needs a Server Action behind an untrusted Host header. The app defines no Server Actions and runs the standalone server (host pinned since 14.2). Patched by upgrade.

Requires attacker-controlled values in ImageResponse SVG content. The only use is app/opengraph-image.tsx, which renders static fonts and the app icon, no request input. Patched by upgrade.

No patched release exists (advisory range is every version through 3.0.3, which is the latest). Reached only via eslint-config-next -> @next/eslint-plugin-next -> fast-glob -> micromatch while ESLint resolves its own fixed glob patterns. Not in npm audit --omit=dev.
rows.mitigation: ESLint runs only on developer machines and in two CI jobs, `quality` (ci.yml) and `compliance-scan` (compliance-check.yml), never in a production image or the db-migrate container command; glob patterns come from the repository ESLint config, not from requests or uploads; neither lint step has deployment secrets (compliance-check.yml passes ENCRYPTION_KEY only to its test step). Re-triage is forced by the gate: the exception is valid through 2026-12-31 and the gate fails from 2027-01-01, and it fails as soon as npm audit reports an available fix for braces (fixAvailable true, a non-breaking upgrade, or an upgrade of braces itself) until the fix is applied or recorded in reviewedFix.
